judge.voice: I liked it. It asked about Roblox and YouTube, so it was not boring or baby stuff. The questions were short and I knew what to do each time. Two early tasks looked the same, which was a bit strange. When I wrote about Adopt Me, it said my story was nearly there, and that felt nice. It told me to put 'a' before 'new cat', and that is something I can actually remember. I am not sure about B1, though. My school English is not that good, and the app said itself it was a careful guess. One answer got a 'not yet' even though the words said it was good. I would use it again after school, and I would tell my cousin. I wish it had also told me about 'played' and 'made', because I get those wrong a lot.
